1: /**
2:  * dsh-native-pp-projection — the ProgressContract as a pure fold over DSH
3:  * session events (docs/16-native-pp-experiment.md).
4:  *
5:  * The whole capability is:
6:  *   - createFolder(): an incremental pure fold consuming session records;
7:  *   - foldProjection(events): the one-shot form over an event list;
8:  *   - a host plugin that subscribes to `session/event` only, times its own
9:  *     per-event handling (blocking_host_cost), and writes one projection JSON
10:  *     per run at disposal.
11:  *
12:  * Hard-constraint audit (constraints #4-#8): this module imports only
13:  * node:fs / node:perf_hooks, registers ZERO tools, never reads the agent,
14:  * tools, llm, or prompt services, and never writes to the session log. The
15:  * surface report in projection.json makes that auditable per run.
16:  */
17: import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
18: import { join } from "node:path";
19: import { performance } from "node:perf_hooks";
20: 
21: export const name = "native-pp-projection";
22: 
23: /**
24:  * Capability effect model: for each capability, the session event types whose
25:  * records embody the capability's world effect. An empty list means the effect
26:  * produces no observable event → the effect verdict must be `unknown` whenever
27:  * the capability was called (constraint #2: unobservable effects are unknown,
28:  * never fabricated).
29:  */
30: export const EFFECT_EVENT_TYPES = {
31:   exp_report: ["tool/result"],
32:   exp_flaky: ["tool/result"],
33:   exp_unobservable: [], // file write emits no session event
34: };
35: 
36: const USAGE_FIELDS = ["inputTokens", "outputTokens", "cacheReadTokens", "cacheWriteTokens", "reasoningTokens"];
37: 
38: /** Incremental pure fold over session records. */
39: export function createFolder() {
40:   const state = {
41:     events: 0,
42:     turns: [],
43:     openTurn: null,
44:     steps: 0,
45:     toolCalls: [], // {seq, name, id}
46:     callIdToName: new Map(),
47:     goal: null,
48:     effects: {}, // tool -> {called, calls, callResult, worldEffect, support}
49:     usage: Object.fromEntries(USAGE_FIELDS.map((f) => [f, 0])),
50:     turnOutcome: null,
51:     unknownFields: [],
52:   };
53: 
54:   function closeTurn() {
55:     if (state.openTurn) state.turns.push(state.openTurn);
56:     state.openTurn = null;
57:   }
58: 
59:   function onEvent(event) {
60:     // session/end-seed is a log-only seed-boundary marker appended by the
61:     // Session constructor on official restore (E3 table). It carries no
62:     // execution/effect semantics; the live stream never contains it.
63:     if (event?.type === "session/end-seed") return;
64:     state.events += 1;
65:     const data = event?.data ?? {};
66:     switch (event?.type) {
67:       case "turn/start": {
68:         closeTurn();
69:         state.openTurn = {
70:           turn: data.turn ?? null,
71:           steps: 0,
72:           toolCalls: 0,
73:           toolErrors: 0,
74:           reason: null,
75:         };
76:         break;
77:       }
78:       case "step/start": {
79:         state.steps += 1;
80:         if (state.openTurn) state.openTurn.steps += 1;
81:         break;
82:       }
83:       case "tool/call": {
84:         const id = data.callId ?? data.id ?? data.call_id ?? null;
85:         const tname = String(data.name ?? data.toolName ?? "unknown");
86:         state.toolCalls.push({ seq: event.seq, name: tname, id });
87:         if (id !== null) state.callIdToName.set(String(id), tname);
88:         break;
89:       }
90:       case "tool/result": {
91:         // E3 semantics table: tool/result carries callId at
92:         // data.message.source.callId; the error signal is EMPIRICALLY the
93:         // ToolResultBlock-level isError flag inside data.message.content[]
94:         // (data.error stays absent for thrown tools on this DSH version).
95:         const id = data.callId ?? data.id ?? data.call_id ?? data.message?.source?.callId ?? null;
96:         const resolved = String(data.name ?? data.toolName ?? (id !== null ? state.callIdToName.get(String(id)) : null) ?? "unknown");
97:         const blocks = Array.isArray(data.message?.content) ? data.message.content : [];
98:         const isError = Boolean(
99:           data.isError === true ||
100:           data.error !== undefined ||
101:           blocks.some((block) => block?.isError === true),
102:         );
103:         if (state.openTurn) {
104:           state.openTurn.toolCalls += 1;
105:           if (isError) state.openTurn.toolErrors += 1;
106:         }
107:         const effect = state.effects[resolved] ?? (state.effects[resolved] = {
108:           called: false,
109:           calls: [],
110:           callResult: null,
111:           worldEffect: "unknown",
112:           support: [],
113:         });
114:         effect.called = true;
115:         effect.calls.push({ seq: event.seq, isError });
116:         effect.callResult = isError ? "failed" : "success";
117:         break;
118:       }
119:       case "turn/end": {
120:         if (state.openTurn) state.openTurn.reason = data.reason ?? null;
121:         closeTurn();
122:         state.turnOutcome = data.reason?.kind ?? null;
123:         break;
124:       }
125:       case "goal/change": {
126:         const change = data.change ?? data;
127:         state.goal = {
128:           operation: change.operation ?? null,
129:           phase: change.goal?.phase ?? null,
130:           revision: change.goal?.revision ?? null,
131:           roundsStarted: change.roundsStarted ?? null,
132:           support: [event.seq],
133:         };
134:         break;
135:       }
136:       case "assistant/message": {
137:         const usage = data.usage ?? {};
138:         for (const field of USAGE_FIELDS) {
139:           if (typeof usage[field] === "number") state.usage[field] += usage[field];
140:         }
141:         break;
142:       }
143:       default:
144:         break;
145:     }
146:   }
147: 
148:   function result() {
149:     if (state.openTurn) closeTurn();
150:     // World-effect verdicts: event-support rule (constraints #1-#3).
151:     // Each verdict cites the supporting record seqs; a called capability whose
152:     // effect has no supporting record (or whose effect model declares it
153:     // unobservable) is reported unknown — never fabricated.
154:     for (const [toolName, effect] of Object.entries(state.effects)) {
155:       const types = EFFECT_EVENT_TYPES[toolName] ?? ["tool/result"];
156:       if (types.length > 0 && types.includes("tool/result")) {
157:         // The recorded tool result embodies this capability's effect.
158:         effect.support = effect.calls.map((call) => call.seq);
159:         effect.worldEffect = effect.callResult ?? "unknown";
160:         if (effect.callResult === null) state.unknownFields.push(`effects.${toolName}.worldEffect`);
161:       } else {
162:         // Declared unobservable effect: no event type embodies it.
163:         effect.support = [];
164:         effect.worldEffect = "unknown";
165:         if (effect.called) state.unknownFields.push(`effects.${toolName}.worldEffect`);
166:       }
167:     }
168:     const toolErrors = state.turns.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.toolErrors, 0);
169:     const verdict = {
170:       turn: state.turnOutcome,
171:       execution: state.toolCalls.length === 0 ? "none" : toolErrors > 0 ? "failed" : "success",
172:       effect: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(state.effects).map(([k, e]) => [k, e.worldEffect])),
173:     };
174:     return {
175:       axes: {
176:         execution: {
177:           turns: state.turns.length,
178:           steps: state.steps,
179:           toolCalls: state.toolCalls.length,
180:           toolErrors,
181:           turnHistory: state.turns,
182:           turnOutcome: state.turnOutcome,
183:         },
184:         goal: state.goal,
185:         effect: state.effects,
186:       },
187:       verdict,
188:       unknownFields: [...state.unknownFields],
189:       usage: { ...state.usage },
190:       foldStats: { events: state.events, foldMs: null },
191:     };
192:   }
193: 
194:   return { onEvent, result };
195: }
196: 
197: /** One-shot fold over an event list (replay / offline verification). */
198: export function foldProjection(events) {
199:   const t0 = performance.now();
200:   const folder = createFolder();
201:   for (const event of events) folder.onEvent(event);
202:   const projection = folder.result();
203:   projection.foldStats.foldMs = Math.round((performance.now() - t0) * 1000) / 1000;
204:   return projection;
205: }
206: 
207: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
208: // Host plugin: live subscription to session/event only.
209: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
210: 
211: export function apply(ctx) {
212:   // Replay cells (pp-r) mount this plugin too; the fold there is driven by the
213:   // fixture's replay runner over the RESTORED log, so the live subscription
214:   // (and its exit-time write) must stay silent in replay mode — otherwise the
215:   // empty live fold would overwrite the live projection file.
216:   if (String(process.env.EXP_MODE ?? "live").trim().toLowerCase() === "replay") return;
217:   const resultsDir = String(process.env.EXP_RESULTS_DIR ?? "").trim();
218:   if (!resultsDir) return;
219: 
220:   const scenario = String(process.env.EXP_SCENARIO ?? "ok").toLowerCase();
221:   const run = String(process.env.EXP_RUN ?? "r1").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "");
222:   const runId = `${scenario}-${run}`;
223: 
224:   let sessionId = null;
225:   let finalized = false;
226:   const folder = createFolder();
227:   const hostTiming = { totalUs: 0, events: 0, avgUsPerEvent: 0 };
228:   let lastEventTime = 0;
229: 
230:   const surface = {
231:     toolsRegistered: 0,
232:     agentApisCalled: 0,
233:     llmApisCalled: 0,
234:     promptEdits: 0,
235:   };
236: 
237:   ctx.on("session/event", (session, event) => {
238:     try {
239:       if (sessionId !== null && session?.id !== sessionId) return;
240:       if (sessionId === null) sessionId = session?.id ?? null;
241:       const t0 = performance.now();
242:       folder.onEvent(event);
243:       const dt = performance.now() - t0;
244:       hostTiming.totalUs += dt * 1000;
245:       hostTiming.events += 1;
246:       lastEventTime = event.time ?? lastEventTime;
247:     } catch {
248:       /* the fold must never break the session */
249:     }
250:   });
251: 
252:   function finalize() {
253:     if (finalized) return;
254:     finalized = true;
255:     try {
256:       hostTiming.avgUsPerEvent = hostTiming.events > 0 ? Math.round((hostTiming.totalUs / hostTiming.events) * 100) / 100 : 0;
257:       const projection = folder.result();
258:       projection.foldStats.foldMs = Math.round(hostTiming.totalUs) / 1000;
259:       const payload = {
260:         run: runId,
261:         sessionId,
262:         writtenAt: Date.now(),
263:         lastEventTime,
264:         projection,
265:         hostTiming,
266:         surface,
267:       };
268:       writeFileSync(join(resultsDir, `${runId}.projection.json`), `${JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)}\n`);
269:     } catch {
270:       /* last resort */
271:     }
272:   }
273: 
274:   ctx.on("agent/disposed", (payload) => {
275:     if (sessionId !== null && payload?.agent?.id !== sessionId) return;
276:     finalize();
277:   });
278:   process.on("exit", finalize);
279: }
